title: I bow my knee in reverence, in awe of Your glory
lyrics: I bow my knee in reverence, in awe of Your glory;
Humbly I approach You now, with praise and adoration.
I lift my hands in worship, giving You all honor;
I'll join the heavenly hosts of angels now and sing
Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,
Who was and is and is to come.
The Lion of Judah, the soon and coming King;
Jesus, You are crowned with praise.
